en: A black‑and‑white street scene in a European town, showing a broad road lined with two‑ and three‑story houses with steep gabled roofs and shuttered windows. On the left is a substantial stone-and-brick wall with ornate pillars and urns, likely surrounding a villa or institutional building. In the middle distance the street narrows and curves slightly uphill between half‑timbered or plastered houses. Numerous people—men with hats, women in long skirts and aprons, and many children—are walking or standing in the street, suggesting a snapshot of everyday life in the early 20th century. The sky area shows crackling or aging of the photographic surface. Along the bottom edge, faint reversed handwriting appears on the negative.
